evidence.detail: Warn you on the sign up page if you are already signed up — added @fill_cookies('deck_id'), loads deck, passes it to SignUp view, shows signed_up_msg_safe
Refined to only show warning when d.is_in_current_run() (i.e., not after 5 matches played)
if d and d.is_in_current_run(): sets signed_up_msg_safe with links to the active deck and the retire page
{{#signed_up_msg_safe}} renders the retire prompt as an error paragraph on the signup page

triage.notes: Detection relies on the deck_id cookie, so users visiting from a different browser without the cookie will not see the prompt. This edge case was apparently accepted as an acceptable limitation.
triage.proposed_comment: This was implemented in commits 7928aa93 and 4c5c3913. The signup page now shows a retire prompt ('You are already signed up to the league with [deck]. Do you want to Retire?') whenever the current browser's deck_id cookie points to a deck still in an active run.

verify.final_comment: This was implemented in commits 7928aa93 and 4c5c3913. The signup page now shows a retire prompt ('You are already signed up to the league with [deck]. Do you want to Retire?') whenever the current browser's deck_id cookie points to a deck still in an active run.

own_evidence.detail: Independently read: checks d.is_in_current_run() and sets signed_up_msg_safe with a deck link and retire link
Confirmed @fill_cookies('deck_id') decorator populates deck_id from browser cookie, then loads the deck and passes it to the SignUp view
